title: Unsafe Diffusion: On the Generation of Unsafe Images and Hateful Memes From Text-To-Image Models
measurement_description: The paper measured the propensity of text-to-image models to generate hateful memes and unsafe images targeting religious groups and figures, such as generating variants of the antisemitic 'Happy Merchant' meme and images targeting the Pope.
findings: The study found that text-to-image models, particularly Stable Diffusion combined with image editing methods like DreamBooth, can be effectively used to generate hateful meme variants targeting religious groups and figures. The models successfully created variants of the antisemitic 'Happy Merchant' meme and produced images targeting the Pope. The root cause for this capability is the presence of unsafe images, including hateful and political content, within the models' training data.
